All 8 completed experiments were synthesis-only (0 compute-bound tasks), led by 'Qualify original learning execution with immutable per-child coverage' (61.19 minutes, accounting for ~44.8% of milestone duration) and 'Qualify original import contracts and current installed inference in separate ro' (29.6 minutes), followed by 'Map qualified new operations while preserving absent cost and physical evidence' (11.4 minutes), 'Measure reset-cause transfer across adapter-withheld live games' (9.54 minutes), and 'Bind thirteen tasks and separate research operands from execution qualification' (9.43 minutes). Because zero compute-bound tasks were run, gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is recorded as null, and 0% utilization on GPU 0 represents expected idle behavior for non-GPU synthesis workloads while GPU 1 maintained active background inference.
bottlenecks_identified: Synthesis-only task execution accounted for 100% of milestone duration (8 completed tasks totaling 136.6 wall-time minutes), with the two longest qualification experiments ('Qualify original learning execution with immutable per-child coverage' at 61.19 minutes and 'Qualify original import contracts and current installed inference in separate ro' at 29.6 minutes) consuming 90.79 minutes, or ~66.5% of total milestone wall time.
The learning execution qualification run executed as an unpartitioned monolithic synthesis pass for 61.19 minutes without granular checkpointing or early-exit failure boundaries.
Separate-root import contracts and installed inference qualification executed for 29.6 minutes without incremental caching of verified environment state or modular contract boundary checks.

Recurring orchestration passes—including mapping qualified new operations (11.4 minutes), measuring reset-cause transfer across live games (9.54 minutes), and binding thirteen tasks (9.43 minutes)—executed full sweeps without memoization on unchanged research operands.

Milestone timing required disk-mtime fallback reconstruction due to the live git-log discovery path discovering 0 commits in the milestone interval, and synthesis experiment receipts lacked structured intra-phase execution timestamps.
improvements_suggested: Partition prolonged learning execution and separate-root import contract qualification runs into modular sub-checks with early failure detection to prevent unmonitored multi-minute executions.
Introduce incremental receipt caching and evidence memoization for recurring operation-mapping, reset-cause measurement, and task-binding passes when upstream inputs remain unchanged.
Persist synchronous start, finish, and elapsed execution timestamps directly into experiment JSON receipts to eliminate reliance on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction.
Instrument synthesis and qualification tasks with intra-task phase timers to isolate latency across environment setup, contract verification, test execution, and receipt serialization.
Preserve DualGPURunner boundaries strictly for concurrent multi-model inference pipelines, avoiding unnecessary GPU allocation or runner overhead on CPU-bound synthesis workloads.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Partition the monolithic learning execution qualification workflow into modular sub-checks instrumented with granular intra-task phase timers.
Implement incremental evidence memoization for recurring task binding, operation mapping, and reset-cause measurement synthesis tasks operating on immutable inputs.
Record explicit synchronous start and end lifecycle timestamps directly into experiment result receipts to replace disk-mtime fallback reconstruction.
meta_reflection: Milestone 2026.10.742 completed 8 synthesis-only experiments in 136.6 wall-time minutes with zero compute-bound tasks and gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks recorded as null. Observed 0% GPU utilization on GPU 0 was appropriate for CPU synthesis workloads, while GPU 1 ran background inference, and no multi-model tasks were present to require DualGPURunner. Future milestone throughput will benefit most from decomposing long-running learning execution and installed inference qualification passes and establishing incremental memoization for unchanged task binding, operation mapping, and reset-cause measurements.
